text: Corvane said its E3 delivery van will travel 510 kilometres on a charge, putting it near the top of the light-commercial EV segment. The claim was made at the company’s quarterly fleet briefing in Brindleport, where chief product officer Mara Venn said the van’s 82-kWh pack was tested on mixed urban routes with a 14% reserve. Pricing starts at 46,800 crowns before incentives, and first customer handovers are due in March. Corvane also said payload remains unchanged at 1,240 kilograms despite the larger battery. For the sector, the figure raises the bar for last-mile operators, especially fleets weighing range against cargo capacity and depot charging cycles.
